subject: Where is my seal kit?
body:
Hello,

I ordered a mechanical seal kit for my VP-100 last week, order ORD-50412. It still hasn't come. Can you tell me when it will be delivered? The pump is leaking a bit so I need it soon.

Thanks,
Ramesh Patil

subject: Order 50433 - any update?
body:
Hi team,
I placed an order for the 8 litre pressure tank on 12th Oct (order no 50433). I haven't received any dispatch message yet. What's the status?
Priya

subject: Impeller delivery for hotel kitchen pump
body:
Dear Sir,

Our kitchen line pump needs the new impeller urgently. Order #50427. Please share the courier name and tracking number so my manager can follow up.

Regards,
Rajesh Iyer
Iyer Hotels, Lonavala

subject: control panel order
body: hi, has the VS-200 control panel we ordered (ORD-50450) been shipped? need it at chakan factory by friday. vikram

subject: Safety rope order stuck?
body:
Namaste,
My order for the 60m safety rope (50455) is showing on hold. Why is that? I need it before the borewell work next week.
Anil Kulkarni, Baramati

subject: Book annual service for borewell pump
body:
Hello,

Our VS-200 submersible was installed in August last year. We would like to book the yearly service visit (cable joint and rope check as per the manual). Any weekday morning next week works for us in Satara.

Thank you,
Deepa Gokhale

subject: Need technician for booster pump
body:
Hi,
Can you send someone to check the pressure switch on our VB-300 at our flat in Hadapsar? The pressure feels low on the 3rd floor. I am home on most afternoons.
Kavita

subject: First maintenance visit
body: Dear team, our booster pump was installed in August. Please schedule the first maintenance visit sometime in the coming days. Regards, Farida Khan

subject: Pump inspection at farm
body:
Sir, please book a technician visit to inspect our borewell pump at the farm in Ahmednagar. Last time there was sand. I want it checked before rabi season. Any day is ok.
Sanjay More

subject: Pump making a gravel-like noise
body:
Hi,

Since yesterday my VP-100 is making a rattling sound, like gravel inside. Water is coming but less than usual. What could be wrong and what should I check?

Ramesh

subject: Booster keeps switching on and off
body:
Hello,
Our VB-300 starts and stops every few seconds with a clicking sound, even when only one tap is open. Is this normal? What should we do?
Priya Nair

subject: Dry run trips on control panel
body:
Our VS-200 control panel keeps tripping on dry run in the afternoons. The borewell is 300 ft. What does this mean and how do we fix it?
Anil

subject: Low voltage at factory
body: Hi, the voltage at our Chakan unit drops to about 190 V in the evenings. Is that safe for the VP-100 or do we need something extra? Vikram Rao

subject: Pump not starting after tank emptied
body: Our overhead tank ran empty this morning and now the booster pump doesn't start. There is a light blinking. What should I do?

subject: Knocking sound in pipe
body: Hello, there is a loud knocking sound in the delivery pipe whenever our submersible pump stops. Is the pump damaged? Deepa

subject: Warranty for my VP-100?
body:
Hello,
My VP-100 (serial VP100-23117) has started leaking near the shaft again. You replaced the seal in April under warranty. Is it still under warranty? Will the repair be free?
Ramesh Patil

subject: Warranty claim - motor problem
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

The motor of our submersible pump VS200-22058 is not running properly, it trips again and again. I want to claim warranty for this. Please let me know the process.

Sunita Deshmukh, Nashik

subject: Is grinding noise covered?
body: Our VS-200 (VS200-25211, installed March this year) is making a grinding noise. If it needs repair, is it covered under warranty?

subject: Warranty on site pump
body: Hi, the VP-100 at our Pimpri site office (VP100-21876) has stopped again. Can we get it repaired under warranty? Mohammed Shaikh

subject: Extended warranty
body: Hello, I would like to know what the warranty on my VB-300 (VB300-25480) covers and whether I can buy an extended warranty. Thanks, Farida

subject: Totally unacceptable service
body:
This is the second time in a month your technician has not turned up after confirming the visit. My site had no water for the whole day and 20 workers were sitting idle. I am extremely disappointed and want this escalated to your manager today.

Mohammed Shaikh
Shaikh Constructions

subject: Why was my order cancelled??
body: I never cancelled order 50441 but your system shows it as cancelled. Nobody answers the phone. This is very poor. I want an explanation and the part delivered immediately.

subject: Overcharged by technician
body: Your technician charged me Rs 2,000 cash last time and gave no receipt. I feel cheated. I want a refund or I will file a complaint in consumer court.

subject: Very disappointed
body: Your pump failed in the middle of our wedding season booking. Third breakdown this year. Frankly I regret buying Vardhan. Someone senior please call me.

subject: Dealership enquiry
body:
Respected Sir,
We are a hardware and pipes shop in Karad for 20 years. We are interested in becoming an authorised Vardhan dealer. Please share the dealer terms.
Regards,
Shree Ganesh Hardware

subject: GST invoice copy needed
body: Hello, please send us a copy of the GST invoice for our September purchase for our records. Thank you, Accounts team

subject: Thank you!
body: Just wanted to say thank you to Amit who installed our booster pump. Very polite and neat work. Kavita

subject: Job for pump technician
body: Sir, I have ITI in electrician trade and 4 years experience in motor rewinding. Are there any openings for technician in Pune?

subject: Quotation for 6 booster pumps
body: Dear Vardhan team, our housing society in Wakad needs a quotation for 6 booster pumps for our towers. Please send prices and delivery time.

subject: Change of phone number
body: Hello, please update my phone number in your records to 9881239999. My old number is no longer in use. Deepa Gokhale
